priorFindingDisposition: No blocker or SHOULD-FIX was outstanding against v2 (Claude ACCEPT 0/0; Codex not reviewed). v3 is a remeasurement plus two self-directed hygiene repairs, both audited above and both landed.
observationsNotFindings: doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone enumerates only two of the four leftoverDesign-true obligations: it names OBL-G19-FX-AUTHORING and OBL-GRANT-JOURNAL, omitting OBL-INHERIT-BLOCKED and OBL-MONOTONIC. This was the strongest candidate for a finding in this review and I traced it fully. It is NOT a finding: the sentence does not assert that the other two are closed, and the complete four-item set is stated in four other places — the authorityClaim names all four explicitly, leftoverDesignOpenStanding covers all four descriptively, summary.leftoverDesign lists all four, and all four per-obligation flags are true (flag set and summary reconcile exactly). doesNot[15] and doesNot[16] additionally disclaim settling the two omitted ones. The field is also byte-identical to the ACCEPTed v2, and v3's stated purpose is a targeted remeasurement that deliberately leaves untouched prose alone. COORDINATOR NOTE, flagged deliberately: recent COORD entries in this run quote their subject's doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone when writing 'leftover-design of X and Y remains' into Decision item 2. If the D-183 entry quotes this field verbatim it will under-report the remainder by half. The authoritative complete set for that sentence is OBL-G19-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-GRANT-JOURNAL, OBL-INHERIT-BLOCKED, and OBL-MONOTONIC.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty-one attacks run, twenty-one refuted. The subject is a genuine remeasurement of frozen v2 onto live HEAD 49d0a31 / file 08 f909ddff / required-now 28, with file 08 confirmed moved; both hygiene repairs landed and the ten-obligation leftoverDesign set is provably identical to v2. This row carries FOUR leftover obligations and all four flags are intact and reconcile exactly with summary.leftoverDesign. Every quoted v11 string and every G19 structural citation is verbatim present, and the two corpus classes are triple-corroborated across G19's two fields and the catalog. ONE ITEM FOR COORDINATOR ATTENTION, logged as an observation rather than a finding: doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone names only two of the four leftovers (omitting OBL-INHERIT-BLOCKED and OBL-MONOTONIC). It asserts no closure and is contradicted by nothing — the complete set appears in the authorityClaim, leftoverDesignOpenStanding, summary.leftoverDesign, and all four flags — and it is byte-identical to the ACCEPTed v2. But recent COORD entries quote this field when writing 'leftover-design of X and Y remains', so a D-183 entry that quotes it verbatim would under-report the remainder by half. The complete set is OBL-G19-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-GRANT-JOURNAL, OBL-INHERIT-BLOCKED, OBL-MONOTONIC.
